author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: Initialize now runs at hub boot. Repeat reports from the sensor no longer restart the fan-alarm clock, an alarm that already fired isn't sent again after a reboot, and a changed alarm threshold applies on save. New Invert sensor option, and a healthStatus attribute that goes offline after two missed wake-ups plus an hour (the driver learns the wake-up interval from the time between wake-ups). Debug logging now turns itself off after 30 minutes, and a new descriptionText logging option (on by default) logs value changes. After updating, click Initialize on the device. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
